summary: Recorded the day after its release, a walk through Special Counsel Robert Mueller's report on Russia's interference in the 2016 US presidential election and Donald Trump's repeated attempts to obstruct the investigation.

evidence.note: IRA agents first travel to the US in 2014 to gather material for fake personas
Facebook and Twitter figures on the reach of IRA-controlled accounts
GRU hacking of the DNC and Podesta, funded with mined bitcoin
Segment on Assange's partisan messages and coordination with Guccifer 2.0
Manafort shares polling data with Kilimnik and pushes a Russia-friendly Ukraine peace plan
Erik Prince and Kirill Dmitriev back-channel meetings in the Seychelles
Second half turns to the obstruction volume: Comey, Sessions and McGahn in 2017-2018
Closing talk on impeachment prospects and the 14 referred investigations still open

notes: Billed on air as a joint BtB / Daily Zeitgeist episode, but it is hosted by Robert in the BtB feed and reacts to news from the day before, so current-affairs rather than crossover (co-produced rule). Report treated as the sole primary subject, so roles are empty; Trump is secondary. Opening on William Barr's 1989-1992 record is background, not counted in covered years. Seth Rich segment is short, so no conspiracy-theories theme.
